# Satellite nowcaster only -- deliberately NOT exported (no `--extra torch`):
# PyTorch's CPU wheel crashes with "Illegal instruction" on CPUs without AVX2
# (e.g. Ivy Bridge/3rd-gen Core), which would take down the whole server the
# first time a forecast is routed to the satellite model. Install it only on a
# CPU with AVX2 (or Apple Silicon), at the version pinned in uv.lock:
#   pip install torch==2.13.0+cpu --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
